notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Saheeli.
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{R}.
description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake with haste.
When the token Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
